paper_metadata.title: Capturing dynamics with noisy quantum computers

summary: The paper proves that parameterized quantum circuits can approximate functions in Lp, C0, and Sobolev Hk spaces under suitable input normalization, and illustrates this with a small numerical experiment using a 2‑qubit, 3‑layer PQC trained with Adam for 100 epochs on 10 training points (repeated 100 times) to approximate the function f(x)=x/(2π).

experiments.description: Numerical experiment training a parameterized quantum circuit to approximate the linear function f*(x)=x/(2π) under different input normalizations and loss functions (ℓl2 vs ℓh1).

algorithm.variant: parameterized quantum circuit regression / hybrid variational quantum machine learning
algorithm.ansatz: 3-layer PQC shown in Fig. 2.3 with alternating Rx(data) and Ry(trainable) gates on each qubit

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Input x is encoded through Rx(ωx) rotations; trainable Ry(θij) layers follow each encoding block. Each qubit is measured in the Pauli-Z basis.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Regression of f*(x)=x/(2π) on x∈[-π,π] by minimizing either ℓl2 or ℓh1 loss between target and PQC output

problem_instance.description: One-dimensional function approximation benchmark used to illustrate expressivity and generalization of PQCs.

dataset_specification.description: Synthetic target function f*(x)=x/(2π) over x∈[-π,π]

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Inputs were min-max normalized to one of three ranges: [-π/2, π/2], [-π, π], or [-2π, 2π].
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Each experiment repeated 100 times; results reported via 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Min-max feature scaling of inputs to specified intervals.

speedup_claims.caveats: This is an expressivity/generalization study with numerical simulations of a parameterized quantum circuit; no classical baseline or speedup claim is reported.

limiting_factors: Experiments performed as classical simulations of a small PQC (2 qubits)
